description: Create new Signature associated with the specified Company.

id.description: Unique identifier of the timesheet signature.

url.description: Direct URL to the full-size signature image.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this signature.

Attachment representing the Signature.

and specify each parameter as form-data together with `data`...
